crowd.buyer: Your audience first, then brands and buyers of a small product
crowd.note: Months to a first dollar for most creators: sponsors and buyers come after people trust you. So the first job is 25 people who want what you post, and a list you own.
not_yet: Don't buy a camera, lights or a course before your first 30 posts.
Don't pitch brands before you have numbers you can show them.
Don't build a paid community before 25 people ask you for more.
